title: 高反射雷射鏡片~High-reflectivity laser mirrors
focus: 把 ppm 級損耗、駐波場與損傷門檻、離子束濺鍍與衰盪量測整合成可驗收的雷射鏡工程~Integrating ppm-level loss, standing-wave field and damage threshold, ion-beam sputtering and ring-down metrology into acceptable laser-mirror engineering
summary: 雷射鏡片與一般高反射膜的差別在於損耗以 ppm 計、功率以損傷門檻計：本課從 1 − R = T + A + S 的損耗帳出發，分析四分之一波堆內的駐波場與損傷起點、超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷、離子束濺鍍與退火對吸收的要求，再用光腔衰盪、光熱吸收與 ISO 21254 損傷測試驗證，最後處理高功率熱效應、安裝污染與規格交接。~A laser mirror differs from an ordinary high reflector in that loss is counted in ppm and power in damage threshold: starting from the loss ledger 1 − R = T + A + S, the course analyses the standing-wave field and damage origin inside a quarter-wave stack, superpolished substrates and nodular defects, ion-beam sputtering and annealing requirements for absorption, then verifies with cavity ring-down, photothermal absorption and ISO 21254 damage testing, and finishes with high-power thermal effects, mounting contamination and specification handoff.

units.anchor: ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S~The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S
units.title: 雷射鏡的損耗帳與穿透極限~Loss ledger and transmission limit of a laser mirror
units.mechanism: 雷射鏡的反射率不是「越接近 1 越好」的單一數字，而是 1 − R = T + A + S 三項的總和：穿透 T 由膜堆的導納決定，可以靠加層數無限壓低；吸收 A 由材料的消光係數與膜內場分佈決定；散射 S 由基板與膜層的粗糙度與缺陷決定。離子束濺鍍的 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ 鏡可以把 A 與 S 各壓到 1 到 5 ppm，所以 T 低於幾個 ppm 之後再加層數已無意義，規格應改寫成「T ≤ 10 ppm、A ≤ 2 ppm、S ≤ 3 ppm」而不是「R ≥ 99.999%」。腔內功率數十 kW 的系統裡，幾個 ppm 的吸收就是數十 mW 的熱，這是損耗帳必須分項的原因。~A laser mirror's reflectance is not a single number to push toward 1 but the sum 1 − R = T + A + S: transmission T is set by the stack admittance and can be driven down without limit by adding layers; absorption A by the materials' extinction coefficients and the field distribution inside the stack; scatter S by substrate and film roughness and defects. Ion-beam-sputtered Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ mirrors reach A and S of 1 to 5 ppm each, so once T is below a few ppm further layers are pointless, and the specification should read T ≤ 10 ppm, A ≤ 2 ppm, S ≤ 3 ppm rather than R ≥ 99.999%. With tens of kilowatts circulating in a cavity, a few ppm of absorption is tens of milliwatts of heat, which is why the ledger must be itemised.
units.model: Glass | (HL)ᴺH | air 的導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_H²/n_s，T ≈ 4n₀/Y。Ta₂O₅/SiO₂（2.10/1.45）於熔融石英（1.45）、1064 nm：N = 15（31 層）時 (2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴，Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵，T ≈ 20 ppm；N = 20（41 層）時 T ≈ 0.5 ppm。若 A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，31 層鏡 R = 1 − 25 ppm = 99.9975%，41 層鏡只升到 99.99945%。~For glass | (HL)ᴺH | air the admittance is Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_H²/n_s and T ≈ 4n₀/Y. For Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ (2.10/1.45) on fused silica (1.45) at 1064 nm: with N = 15 (31 layers), (2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴, Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵ and T ≈ 20 ppm; with N = 20 (41 layers) T ≈ 0.5 ppm. If A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm, the 31-layer mirror has R = 1 − 25 ppm = 99.9975% and the 41-layer mirror only rises to 99.99945%.
units.verify: 分別量 T（以功率計在高功率下量穿透光，或以光腔衰盪求 1 − R）、A（光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折）與 S（總積分散射儀），確認三項相加與衰盪得到的 1 − R 在 20% 內一致；比較 31 層與 41 層樣品的 1 − R，確認差異被 A + S 的底限掩蓋。~Measure T (transmitted power at high incident power, or 1 − R by cavity ring-down), A (photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection) and S (total integrated scatter) separately and confirm that their sum agrees with the ring-down 1 − R within 20%; compare 1 − R of 31- and 41-layer samples to confirm the difference is masked by the A + S floor.
units.failure: 規格只寫 R ≥ 99.99% 並以分光光度計驗收，實際鏡片吸收 50 ppm，在 20 kW 腔內功率下吸收 1 W，熱透鏡使模態失穩，鏡片在數小時後損傷。~A specification of only R ≥ 99.99% verified by spectrophotometer passes a mirror absorbing 50 ppm; at 20 kW circulating power it absorbs 1 W, thermal lensing destabilises the mode and the mirror fails after hours.
units.misconception: 多加幾對膜層就能讓雷射鏡的損耗無限趨近於零。~Adding more layer pairs drives a laser mirror's loss arbitrarily close to zero.

units.anchor: 膜堆內的駐波場與第一個 H/L 界面~Standing-wave field and the first H/L interface
units.title: 駐波場分佈、損傷起點與材料能隙~Standing-wave field, damage origin and material band gap
units.mechanism: 高反射堆前方的入射波與反射波形成駐波，進入膜堆後逐對衰減。以高折射率層結尾的四分之一波堆在空氣界面是波節，場強最大值落在第一個 H/L 界面，之後每深一對就乘上 (n_L/n_H)²，所以吸收與損傷幾乎都由最上面幾對決定。奈秒脈衝的損傷由缺陷吸收引發熱爆裂，飛秒脈衝則由多光子與雪崩游離主導，門檻隨材料能隙上升：SiO₂ 約 9 eV、HfO₂ 約 5.6 eV、Ta₂O₅ 約 4 eV、TiO₂ 約 3.3 eV，因此高損傷門檻鏡用 HfO₂/SiO₂，最低吸收鏡用 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂。~The incident and reflected waves in front of a high reflector form a standing wave that decays pair by pair inside the stack. A quarter-wave stack ending in a high-index layer has a node at the air interface, the field maximum sits at the first H/L interface, and each deeper pair multiplies the intensity by (n_L/n_H)², so absorption and damage are governed almost entirely by the top few pairs. Nanosecond damage is initiated by defect absorption and thermal explosion, while femtosecond damage is dominated by multiphoton and avalanche ionisation whose threshold rises with band gap: about 9 eV for SiO₂, 5.6 eV for HfO₂, 4 eV for Ta₂O₅ and 3.3 eV for TiO₂, which is why high-threshold mirrors use HfO₂/SiO₂ and lowest-absorption mirrors Ta₂O₅/SiO₂.
units.model: 矩陣計算（Ta₂O₅/SiO₂、(HL)¹⁵H、1064 nm）：空氣界面 |E/E₀|² = 0，第一個 H/L 界面 0.91，第二個 0.43，第三個 0.21，衰減比 (1.45/2.10)² ≈ 0.48；前五對承擔約 95% 的場能。在最外層加一層半波 SiO₂ 保護層，T 不變（20 ppm），但 SiO₂ 層中央出現 |E/E₀|² ≈ 1.90 的波腹，第一個 H/L 界面仍為 0.91，所以保護層只有在 SiO₂ 門檻遠高於 Ta₂O₅ 時才改善損傷。~Matrix calculation for Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ (HL)¹⁵H at 1064 nm: |E/E₀|² = 0 at the air interface, 0.91 at the first H/L interface, 0.43 at the second and 0.21 at the third, a ratio of (1.45/2.10)² ≈ 0.48 per pair, with the top five pairs carrying about 95% of the field energy. Adding a half-wave SiO₂ overcoat leaves T unchanged at 20 ppm but places an antinode of |E/E₀|² ≈ 1.90 in the middle of the SiO₂ while the first H/L interface stays at 0.91, so the overcoat helps only because SiO₂'s threshold is far above Ta₂O₅'s.
units.verify: 用薄膜軟體輸出駐波場分佈並標出各界面的場強，與上述數值核對；對同一膜系做有無半波保護層的 1-on-1 損傷測試，比較門檻與損傷形貌，用聚焦離子束截面確認損傷是否起始於第一個 H/L 界面。~Output the standing-wave profile from thin-film software, mark the field at every interface and check against the values above; run 1-on-1 damage tests on the same stack with and without the half-wave overcoat, compare thresholds and damage morphology, and confirm by focused-ion-beam cross-section whether damage starts at the first H/L interface.
units.failure: 為了拓寬波段改用 TiO₂/SiO₂ 製作 355 nm 高反射鏡，TiO₂ 的能隙 3.3 eV 低於光子能量 3.5 eV，膜層直接吸收，門檻降到原來的十分之一且數分鐘內出現燒蝕。~Switching to TiO₂/SiO₂ for a 355 nm high reflector to widen the band puts TiO₂'s 3.3 eV gap below the 3.5 eV photon energy; the film absorbs directly, the threshold drops tenfold and ablation appears within minutes.
units.misconception: 雷射損傷總是從鏡片最外面的表面開始。~Laser damage always starts at the outermost surface of the mirror.

units.anchor: 超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷~Superpolished substrate and nodular defects
units.title: 超拋光基板、散射與節瘤缺陷~Superpolished substrates, scatter and nodular defects
units.mechanism: 鏡片的散射下限由基板粗糙度決定，膜層會複製基板的形貌。雷射鏡基板通常是熔融石英或低膨脹玻璃，經超拋光到 0.1 到 0.2 nm RMS，表面品質達 10-5 等級，並在潔淨室中清洗後立刻進入鍍膜腔。基板上任何殘留微粒在厚膜堆中會長成倒錐形的節瘤缺陷，節瘤直徑隨種子直徑與膜厚的乘積開平方增長，而節瘤邊界的場強集中使局部損傷門檻遠低於無缺陷區，所以損傷統計往往是由缺陷密度而非材料本質決定。~A mirror's scatter floor is set by substrate roughness, which the film replicates. Laser-mirror substrates are usually fused silica or low-expansion glass superpolished to 0.1 to 0.2 nm RMS with 10-5 surface quality, cleaned in a clean room and loaded into the chamber immediately. Any residual particle on the substrate grows through a thick stack into an inverted-cone nodular defect whose diameter scales as the square root of seed diameter times film thickness, and field concentration at the nodule boundary makes the local damage threshold far lower than defect-free film, so damage statistics are often governed by defect density rather than intrinsic material limits.
units.model: 總積分散射 S ≈ (4πσ/λ)²：σ = 0.1 nm、λ = 1064 nm 時 S ≈ (1.18×10⁻³)² ≈ 1.4 ppm；σ = 0.3 nm 時約 12.5 ppm，超過整個損耗預算。節瘤直徑 D ≈ √(C·d·t)，取 C ≈ 8：直徑 d = 0.2 µm 的種子埋在 t = 5 µm 的膜堆下長成 D ≈ √(8×0.2×5) ≈ 2.8 µm 的節瘤；若每 cm² 有 10 個這種缺陷，直徑 2 mm 的光斑內平均有 0.3 個，損傷機率由缺陷密度主導。~Total integrated scatter S ≈ (4πσ/λ)²: with σ = 0.1 nm and λ = 1064 nm, S ≈ (1.18×10⁻³)² ≈ 1.4 ppm; with σ = 0.3 nm about 12.5 ppm, exceeding the whole loss budget. Nodule diameter D ≈ √(C·d·t) with C ≈ 8: a seed of d = 0.2 µm under a t = 5 µm stack grows into D ≈ √(8×0.2×5) ≈ 2.8 µm; with 10 such defects per cm², a 2 mm diameter spot contains 0.3 on average, so damage probability is governed by defect density.
units.verify: 鍍膜前用白光干涉儀與 AFM 量基板粗糙度 PSD，預測散射並與鍍膜後的 TIS 量測比較；以暗場顯微鏡掃描鍍後表面統計節瘤密度與直徑分佈，用節瘤公式反推種子大小，並與損傷測試中損傷點位置做對照。~Measure substrate roughness PSD by white-light interferometry and AFM before coating, predict scatter and compare with post-coating TIS; map nodule density and diameter distribution by dark-field microscopy, infer seed size from the nodule relation and correlate with damage-site locations from threshold testing.
units.failure: 基板從拋光廠到鍍膜腔之間放置數日，表面吸附微粒與有機物，鍍後節瘤密度升高十倍，散射 15 ppm 且 1-on-1 損傷門檻只有乾淨批次的一半。~Substrates left for days between the polishing shop and the chamber pick up particles and organics; after coating the nodule density is ten times higher, scatter reaches 15 ppm and the 1-on-1 threshold is half that of a clean batch.
units.misconception: 只要膜層夠好，基板的粗糙度與清潔度無關緊要。~With a good enough film the substrate's roughness and cleanliness do not matter.

units.anchor: 離子束濺鍍腔、氧分壓與退火爐~IBS chamber, oxygen partial pressure and annealing furnace
units.title: 離子束濺鍍、化學計量與退火~Ion-beam sputtering, stoichiometry and annealing
units.mechanism: 雷射鏡幾乎都以離子束濺鍍沉積：氬離子束轟擊 Ta 或 Ta₂O₅ 靶，濺出的原子帶著數 eV 能量到達基板，形成緻密、非晶、低散射的膜，腔內通入氧氣維持氧化物的化學計量，否則缺氧的 TaOₓ 會帶來 ppm 以上的吸收。沉積速率只有約 0.1 nm/s，一片 41 層、6 µm 的鏡需十幾小時，過程中靶材老化與氧分壓漂移都會改變折射率。鍍後在數百度退火可以降低吸收與機械損耗並釋放部分壓應力，是重力波探測器鏡片與高精度腔鏡的標準工序。~Laser mirrors are almost always deposited by ion-beam sputtering: an argon-ion beam strikes a Ta or Ta₂O₅ target, the sputtered atoms arrive with several eV and form dense, amorphous, low-scatter films, and oxygen is admitted to keep the oxide stoichiometric, since oxygen-deficient TaOₓ brings absorption above ppm. The rate is only about 0.1 nm/s, so a 41-layer, 6 µm mirror takes well over ten hours, during which target ageing and oxygen-pressure drift alter the index. Post-deposition annealing at several hundred degrees lowers absorption and mechanical loss and relaxes part of the compressive stress, a standard step for gravitational-wave-detector mirrors and high-precision cavity mirrors.
units.model: 吸收主要發生在場強最大的前幾個 Ta₂O₅ 層：場加權的有效 Ta₂O₅ 厚度 ≈ d_H × Σ0.91×0.48ᵏ × 0.5 ≈ 127 nm × 1.73 × 0.5 ≈ 110 nm。要使 A ≤ 1 ppm，需 α_H × 110 nm ≤ 10⁻⁶，即 α_H ≤ 0.09 cm⁻¹，換算消光係數 k = αλ/4π ≈ 0.09 × 1.064×10⁻⁴/12.6 ≈ 7.6×10⁻⁷。41 層總厚 20×(127 + 183) + 127 ≈ 6.3 µm，以 0.1 nm/s 沉積需 ≈ 17.6 h。~Absorption occurs mainly in the top Ta₂O₅ layers where the field is strongest: the field-weighted effective Ta₂O₅ thickness ≈ d_H × Σ0.91×0.48ᵏ × 0.5 ≈ 127 nm × 1.73 × 0.5 ≈ 110 nm. For A ≤ 1 ppm, α_H × 110 nm ≤ 10⁻⁶, so α_H ≤ 0.09 cm⁻¹, an extinction coefficient k = αλ/4π ≈ 0.09 × 1.064×10⁻⁴/12.6 ≈ 7.6×10⁻⁷. The 41-layer total thickness is 20×(127 + 183) + 127 ≈ 6.3 µm, about 17.6 h at 0.1 nm/s.
units.verify: 用光熱共路干涉儀量退火前後的吸收，確認由數 ppm 降到 1 ppm 等級；以橢偏儀量單層 Ta₂O₅ 的 n、k，核對 k 是否低於 10⁻⁶；用薄片基板的曲率變化追蹤退火對壓應力的釋放，並以分光光度計確認退火後光譜位移小於 0.2%。~Measure absorption before and after annealing with photothermal common-path interferometry, confirming a drop from several ppm to the 1 ppm level; measure n and k of a single Ta₂O₅ layer by ellipsometry and check k below 10⁻⁶; track stress relaxation through curvature change of thin substrates and confirm by spectrophotometry that the post-anneal spectral shift is below 0.2%.
units.failure: 氧氣流量計漂移使氧分壓下降 30%，Ta₂O₅ 層缺氧，吸收從 1 ppm 升到 40 ppm，在高功率腔內鏡片中心升溫形成熱透鏡，腔模式失鎖。~A drifting oxygen flow controller lowers the partial pressure by 30%, the Ta₂O₅ layers become oxygen-deficient, absorption rises from 1 ppm to 40 ppm, the mirror centre heats in the high-power cavity, a thermal lens forms and the cavity loses lock.
units.misconception: 鍍膜完成後膜層性質就固定了，退火只是可有可無的額外步驟。~Film properties are fixed once deposition ends, so annealing is an optional extra.

units.anchor: 光腔衰盪與光熱吸收量測~Cavity ring-down and photothermal absorption measurement
units.title: ppm 損耗的量測：衰盪、光熱與散射~Measuring ppm loss: ring-down, photothermal and scatter
units.mechanism: 分光光度計的絕對精度約 0.1%，等於 1000 ppm，對雷射鏡毫無用處。損耗必須用光腔衰盪量測：把兩片鏡組成光腔，注入雷射後突然關斷，腔內光強以指數衰減，時間常數由腔長與鏡片總損耗決定，測時間比測光強準得多。吸收另以光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折量測，把泵浦雷射造成的微小熱膨脹與折射率變化轉成訊號，校正後可達 0.1 ppm；散射以總積分散射儀收集半球內的散射光。三者分別量測再相加，才是完整的損耗帳。~A spectrophotometer's absolute accuracy of about 0.1% equals 1000 ppm and is useless for laser mirrors. Loss must be measured by cavity ring-down: two mirrors form a cavity, the laser is switched off abruptly, the stored light decays exponentially with a time constant set by cavity length and total mirror loss, and time is measured far more accurately than intensity. Absorption is measured separately by photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection, converting the tiny thermal expansion and index change produced by a pump laser into a signal with 0.1 ppm resolution after calibration; scatter is collected over a hemisphere by a total-integrated-scatter instrument. Only the three measured separately and summed form the complete ledger.
units.model: 兩片相同鏡、腔長 L 的衰盪時間 τ = L/[c·(1 − R)]。L = 0.5 m：R = 0.9999 時 τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 10⁻⁴) ≈ 16.7 µs；R = 0.99999 時 ≈ 167 µs；本課的 31 層鏡（1 − R = 25 ppm）τ ≈ 66.7 µs。若 τ 的量測精度為 1%，1 − R 的解析度約 0.25 ppm，遠優於任何光度法。~For two identical mirrors in a cavity of length L the ring-down time is τ = L/[c·(1 − R)]. With L = 0.5 m: τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 10⁻⁴) ≈ 16.7 µs at R = 0.9999, about 167 µs at R = 0.99999, and about 66.7 µs for this course's 31-layer mirror (1 − R = 25 ppm). With τ measured to 1%, the resolution in 1 − R is about 0.25 ppm, far beyond any photometric method.
units.verify: 以三片鏡兩兩組腔做三次衰盪量測，解聯立方程得到每片鏡各自的損耗；把衰盪求得的 1 − R 與光熱吸收加 TIS 散射再加功率計量到的 T 相比，確認差異在 2 ppm 內；用已知損耗的參考鏡定期檢查衰盪裝置的對準與偵測器線性。~Measure three mirrors pairwise in three ring-down cavities and solve the simultaneous equations for each mirror's individual loss; compare the ring-down 1 − R with photothermal absorption plus TIS scatter plus power-meter transmission, requiring agreement within 2 ppm; check the ring-down setup's alignment and detector linearity regularly with a reference mirror of known loss.
units.failure: 衰盪腔內有高階橫模同時振盪，衰減曲線成為多指數，擬合得到的 τ 偏短，鏡片損耗被高估三倍而誤判不合格；或以分光光度計的 99.95% 讀值當作合格證據，實際損耗根本無法分辨。~Higher-order transverse modes oscillating in the ring-down cavity make the decay multi-exponential, the fitted τ is short and the mirror loss is overestimated threefold, rejecting a good part; a spectrophotometer reading of 99.95% taken as evidence proves nothing about ppm loss.
units.misconception: 分光光度計測到 99.99% 就證明鏡片損耗只有 100 ppm。~A spectrophotometer reading of 99.99% proves the mirror loses only 100 ppm.

units.anchor: ISO 21254 損傷測試與脈寬縮放表~ISO 21254 damage test and pulse-width scaling table
units.title: 損傷門檻測試、縮放律與安全係數~Damage-threshold testing, scaling laws and safety factor
units.mechanism: 損傷門檻依 ISO 21254 以 1-on-1（每點一發）或 S-on-1（每點多發）測試，在多個能量密度各打數十點，統計損傷機率對能量密度的曲線，把機率外推到零得到門檻，並記錄波長、脈寬、光斑大小、重複率與損傷判定方法。門檻隨脈寬在奈秒熱擴散區近似以平方根縮放，隨波長近似線性，光斑越大掃到缺陷的機率越高而門檻越低；這些縮放只是估計，跨越物理機制（例如進入飛秒區）時完全失效。工程上以高斯光束的峰值能量密度與門檻比較，並留二到五倍的安全係數。~Thresholds are tested per ISO 21254 in 1-on-1 (one shot per site) or S-on-1 (many shots per site) mode: tens of sites are irradiated at each of several fluences, damage probability is plotted against fluence and extrapolated to zero probability, and wavelength, pulse width, spot size, repetition rate and the damage criterion are recorded. In the nanosecond thermal-diffusion regime the threshold scales roughly with the square root of pulse width and roughly linearly with wavelength, and larger spots find more defects and give lower thresholds; these scalings are estimates only and fail completely when the physics changes, as in the femtosecond regime. Engineering compares the Gaussian beam's peak fluence with the threshold and keeps a safety factor of two to five.
units.model: 證書：20 J/cm²，1064 nm，10 ns，1-on-1。換算到 5 ns：20×√(5/10) ≈ 14.1 J/cm²；換算到 532 nm、10 ns：20×(532/1064) ≈ 10 J/cm²。使用條件：200 mJ、1/e² 半徑 w = 2 mm 的高斯光束，峰值能量密度 F = 2E/(πw²) = 0.4/(π×0.04) ≈ 3.2 J/cm²，在 1064 nm、8 ns 下門檻 ≈ 20×√0.8 ≈ 17.9 J/cm²，安全係數 ≈ 5.6。~Certificate: 20 J/cm², 1064 nm, 10 ns, 1-on-1. Scaled to 5 ns: 20×√(5/10) ≈ 14.1 J/cm²; to 532 nm at 10 ns: 20×(532/1064) ≈ 10 J/cm². Use case: a 200 mJ Gaussian beam with 1/e² radius w = 2 mm has peak fluence F = 2E/(πw²) = 0.4/(π×0.04) ≈ 3.2 J/cm²; at 1064 nm and 8 ns the threshold ≈ 20×√0.8 ≈ 17.9 J/cm², a safety factor ≈ 5.6.
units.verify: 委託依 ISO 21254 的測試實驗室做 1-on-1 與 S-on-1，取得損傷機率曲線而不只是一個數字；在自己的系統上以 Nomarski 或暗場顯微鏡檢查曝照後的鏡面，與證書的損傷判定標準對照；把實際光斑與脈寬代入縮放公式，確認安全係數並記錄在規格表。~Commission 1-on-1 and S-on-1 tests from an ISO 21254 laboratory and obtain the full damage-probability curve, not just a number; inspect the irradiated surface in your own system with Nomarski or dark-field microscopy against the certificate's damage criterion; substitute your actual spot and pulse width into the scaling relations to confirm the safety factor and record it on the specification sheet.
units.failure: 把 10 ns 的證書門檻直接套用到 300 fs 雷射，飛秒損傷由能隙而非熱擴散決定，實際門檻只有換算值的幾十分之一，鏡片在首次滿功率時損傷；或以平均能量密度而非高斯峰值做比較，把安全係數高估一倍。~Applying a 10 ns certificate to a 300 fs laser, where damage is set by band gap rather than thermal diffusion, overestimates the threshold by tens of times and the mirror fails at first full power; comparing average instead of Gaussian peak fluence doubles the apparent safety factor.
units.misconception: 損傷門檻是鏡片的固定材料常數，與脈寬、波長和光斑無關。~The damage threshold is a fixed material constant independent of pulse width, wavelength and spot size.

units.anchor: 高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制~High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control
units.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染~High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination
units.mechanism: 連續波高功率下，鏡片吸收的功率在光斑中心形成溫度峰，熱膨脹把表面頂成一個凸起，反射波前因此帶有離焦與球差，腔的穩定區隨功率漂移；基板熱導率越高、光斑越大，溫升越小。安裝時的夾持力會在面形上壓出像散，所以用三點運動學或撓性座並控制扭矩。污染是壽命殺手：鏡面吸附的碳氫化合物在紫外或高功率下碳化，形成吸收中心並降低門檻，真空或密閉腔內必須控制除氣材料並維持潔淨。~Under high continuous-wave power the absorbed power forms a temperature peak at the beam centre, thermal expansion raises a bump on the surface, the reflected wavefront acquires defocus and spherical aberration, and the cavity stability region drifts with power; higher substrate conductivity and larger spots reduce the rise. Clamping forces during mounting press astigmatism into the figure, so three-point kinematic or flexure mounts with controlled torque are used. Contamination is the lifetime killer: adsorbed hydrocarbons carbonise under ultraviolet or high power, forming absorption centres and lowering the threshold, so outgassing materials in sealed or vacuum cavities must be controlled and cleanliness maintained.
units.model: 高斯光束在半無限基板表面的中心溫升 ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w)。10 kW 入射、A = 10 ppm → P_abs = 0.1 W；熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、w = 2 mm：ΔT ≈ 0.1/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 14 K；表面凸起 ≈ α·ΔT·w ≈ 0.55×10⁻⁶ × 14 × 2 mm ≈ 15 nm，反射波前變形約 30 nm ≈ λ/35。改用 κ = 400 W/(m·K) 的銅基板，ΔT ≈ 0.05 K。~The centre temperature rise of a Gaussian beam on a semi-infinite substrate is ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w). With 10 kW incident and A = 10 ppm, P_abs = 0.1 W; for fused silica κ = 1.38 W/(m·K) and w = 2 mm, ΔT ≈ 0.1/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 14 K; the surface bump ≈ α·ΔT·w ≈ 0.55×10⁻⁶ × 14 × 2 mm ≈ 15 nm, a reflected-wavefront distortion of about 30 nm ≈ λ/35. A copper substrate with κ = 400 W/(m·K) gives ΔT ≈ 0.05 K.
units.verify: 在功率逐步上升時用 Hartmann 或干涉儀量反射波前，擷取離焦項隨功率的斜率並與熱模型比較；安裝前後各量一次面形，相減得到夾持像散並調整扭矩直到小於 λ/50；以表面分析或在線監測吸收的時間趨勢判斷污染累積。~Measure the reflected wavefront with a Hartmann sensor or interferometer while stepping up power, extract the slope of the defocus term against power and compare with the thermal model; measure figure before and after mounting, subtract to obtain clamping astigmatism and adjust torque until it is below λ/50; judge contamination build-up from surface analysis or the time trend of in-line absorption.
units.failure: 鏡片以彈簧壓片硬夾，面形出現 λ/8 的像散使腔模式變橢圓；腔內使用的黏著劑除氣，三個月後鏡面吸收從 2 ppm 升到 30 ppm，輸出功率逐週下降。~A mirror hard-clamped by a spring retainer carries λ/8 of astigmatism and the cavity mode turns elliptical; an outgassing adhesive inside the cavity raises surface absorption from 2 ppm to 30 ppm within three months and the output power declines week by week.
units.misconception: 鏡片驗收合格後，安裝與使用環境不會再改變它的性能。~Once a mirror passes acceptance, mounting and the operating environment cannot change its performance.

units.anchor: 雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接~Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff
units.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接~Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 雷射鏡規格表必須分項列出：工作波長與入射角、偏振、T、A、S 各自的上限與量測方法、損傷門檻及其測試條件、面形與表面品質、超快應用的群延遲色散、以及清潔方式限制。驗收以衰盪與光熱量測為準，並設保護帶。系統端把每片鏡的損耗代入腔的往返損耗，計算精細度與腔內功率增益，確認與設計一致。交接資料含鍍膜批號、見證片衰盪紀錄、損傷證書、退火紀錄與基板來源，使未來任何一片鏡的異常都能回溯到製程。~A laser-mirror specification must itemise working wavelength and incidence angle, polarization, separate ceilings and measurement methods for T, A and S, the damage threshold with its test conditions, figure and surface quality, group-delay dispersion for ultrafast use, and cleaning limits. Acceptance relies on ring-down and photothermal measurements with a guard band. The system side enters each mirror's loss into the cavity round-trip loss to compute finesse and intracavity power build-up and checks them against the design. The handoff holds the coating run number, witness ring-down records, damage certificate, annealing record and substrate origin, so any later anomaly in any mirror can be traced to its process.
units.model: 兩片鏡各 T = 10 ppm、A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，往返損耗 ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm，精細度 F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵，腔內功率增益 ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴；若某片鏡 S 升到 13 ppm，ℓ = 40 ppm，F 降到 1.6×10⁵。衰盪驗收保護帶：規格 1 − R ≤ 25 ppm、量測不確定度 1 ppm，則判定門檻為 24 ppm。~Two mirrors each with T = 10 ppm, A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm give a round-trip loss ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm, finesse F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵ and intracavity build-up ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴; if one mirror's S rises to 13 ppm, ℓ = 40 ppm and F falls to 1.6×10⁵. Ring-down guard band: with a specification of 1 − R ≤ 25 ppm and 1 ppm measurement uncertainty, the pass threshold is 24 ppm.
units.verify: 把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件，並確認損傷證書的脈寬與波長與使用條件一致或已正確縮放。~After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses; a discrepancy above 20% sends you back to mounting contamination and alignment. Check that every specification line has a matching measurement record and that the damage certificate's pulse width and wavelength match the use conditions or have been properly scaled.
units.failure: 規格表寫「R > 99.99%、高損傷門檻」而沒有分項與測試條件，供應商以分光光度計與未註明脈寬的門檻交貨，腔的精細度只達設計的四分之一且鏡片在滿功率下損傷，雙方無法釐清責任。~A sheet reading R > 99.99% and high damage threshold without itemised terms or test conditions is met with a spectrophotometer reading and an unspecified-pulse threshold; the cavity reaches a quarter of the designed finesse, the mirror fails at full power and responsibility cannot be assigned.
units.misconception: 雷射鏡規格只需要反射率百分比和一個損傷門檻數字。~A laser-mirror specification needs only a reflectance percentage and one damage-threshold number.

example: 1064 nm Q 開關雷射腔鏡練習：Ta₂O₅/SiO₂（2.10/1.45）於熔融石英，設計 (HL)¹⁵H 加半波 SiO₂ 保護層。穿透：(2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴，Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵，T ≈ 4/Y ≈ 20 ppm。散射：基板 σ = 0.15 nm，S ≈ (4π×0.15/1064)² ≈ 3.1 ppm；吸收：退火後 A ≈ 2 ppm；1 − R ≈ 25 ppm，R ≈ 99.9975%。衰盪驗收：L = 0.5 m 的雙鏡腔 τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 2.5×10⁻⁵) ≈ 66.7 µs，量測 1% 精度對應 0.25 ppm。損傷：證書 20 J/cm²（10 ns、1-on-1），使用 8 ns 換算 17.9 J/cm²；200 mJ、w = 2 mm 的峰值能量密度 2×0.2/(π×0.04) ≈ 3.2 J/cm²，安全係數 5.6。熱效應：1 kHz 重複率平均功率 200 W，吸收 2 ppm 即 0.4 mW，ΔT ≈ 0.0004/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 0.06 K，可忽略。駐波場：第一個 H/L 界面 |E/E₀|² ≈ 0.91，保護層中央 1.90。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。~Cavity-mirror exercise for a 1064 nm Q-switched laser: Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ (2.10/1.45) on fused silica, design (HL)¹⁵H plus a half-wave SiO₂ overcoat. Transmission: (2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴, Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵, T ≈ 4/Y ≈ 20 ppm. Scatter: substrate σ = 0.15 nm gives S ≈ (4π×0.15/1064)² ≈ 3.1 ppm; absorption after annealing A ≈ 2 ppm; 1 − R ≈ 25 ppm, R ≈ 99.9975%. Ring-down acceptance: a two-mirror cavity with L = 0.5 m has τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 2.5×10⁻⁵) ≈ 66.7 µs, and 1% timing precision resolves 0.25 ppm. Damage: certificate 20 J/cm² (10 ns, 1-on-1) scales to 17.9 J/cm² at the 8 ns in use; a 200 mJ pulse with w = 2 mm has peak fluence 2×0.2/(π×0.04) ≈ 3.2 J/cm², safety factor 5.6. Thermal: at 1 kHz the average power is 200 W, 2 ppm absorption is 0.4 mW and ΔT ≈ 0.0004/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 0.06 K, negligible. Standing wave: |E/E₀|² ≈ 0.91 at the first H/L interface and 1.90 in the middle of the overcoat. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.
history: 1960 年 Maiman 的紅寶石雷射以鍍銀端面作鏡，數年內介電多層膜取代金屬成為雷射鏡的標準；1980 年代為了環形雷射陀螺儀的 ppm 級損耗，離子束濺鍍被發展成雷射鏡的主流製程，1994 年 Szipőcs 與 Krausz 等人提出的啁啾鏡把色散控制帶入超快雷射。重力波探測器把要求推到極限：LIGO 與 Virgo 的測試質量鏡以 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ 多層膜達到次 ppm 吸收，並把鍍膜熱噪聲列為靈敏度極限之一。損傷門檻測試先後由 ISO 11254 與 ISO 21254 標準化。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~Maiman's 1960 ruby laser used silvered end faces as mirrors, and within a few years dielectric multilayers replaced metal as the standard; in the 1980s ion-beam sputtering became the mainstream laser-mirror process to reach ppm loss for ring-laser gyroscopes, and in 1994 Szipőcs, Krausz and colleagues introduced chirped mirrors that brought dispersion control to ultrafast lasers. Gravitational-wave detectors pushed the requirements to the limit: the LIGO and Virgo test-mass mirrors use Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ multilayers with sub-ppm absorption and treat coating thermal noise as one of the sensitivity limits. Damage-threshold testing was standardised first by ISO 11254 and then by ISO 21254. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.
